summary: test_bootstrap_never_repairs_or_replaces_an_invalid_destination parametrizes over invalid/insecure/directory/symlink and asserts (st_ino,st_mode,st_uid,st_size)+bytes+symlink-target unchanged after a raised ValueError, so any repair (chmod 0644->0600), truncate, or replace of the forbidden destination fails it; no mocks, real fs.
